messages:
Maria Lopez: Hey team - Acme Bank legal is asking for a temporary SOC 2 confirmation + bridge letter for the POC. They say they need an NDA signed and either a bridge letter or extracts by EOD PST. Can we do extracts instead of the full report?
Samir Patel: We can provide limited extracts. Need to confirm scope (controls vs line items) and redaction rules. Also how long will the bridge letter be valid? They asked for 90 days but our standard is 30. :thinking_face:
Jenna (Legal): We can sign the NDA quickly. For the bridge letter, Ops prefers 30-day interim acknowledgement. If they insist on 90 days we can do a 90-day letter with additional indemnity language — need C-level approval. For extracts: we require redaction of any customer-specific evidence.
Ravi (SecOps): Agree with Jenna. We can share control narratives and selected test summaries. We should NOT share raw logs or customer names. Typical extract delivery is an S3 share with a short-lived signed URL. Example path we use for POCs (placeholder):
```
s3://redwood-temp/evidence/acme-poc/2026-03-21/
```
Expires after we rotate links. Also will watermark pdfs with "For Vendor Risk Review - Not a SOC 2 Report".
Ben (SE): For the POC they asked for infra details and KMS/HSM confirmation. Ravi - can you confirm we provide KMS usage statement and CMK scope in the extract? I can include a line in the POC proposal so they don't block the demo.
Ravi (SecOps): Yes — we can include a short KMS controls excerpt (key rotation, access controls) but no key material. We'll include excerpts: Key management, Access control, Logging.
Jenna (Legal): Action items: 1) Maria to send NDA draft to customer (I can review). 2) Ravi to prepare redacted extracts and watermark. 3) Samir to draft the bridge letter template for 30/90-day options and escalate if 90 required. 4) Ben to update POC doc with the KMS blurb. I'll try to approve the NDA by EOD if it's standard.
Maria Lopez: Thanks — I'll push NDA now and cc Jenna. If they sign before 4pm PST we can drop the extracts link and the interim acknowledgement the same day. cc @bridge-bot for tracking :white_check_mark: 
bridge-bot: Ticket created: VRR-4721. Due: 2026-03-21 23:59 UTC. Assigned: Ravi (SecOps), Jenna (Legal).
Samir Patel: One more thing - pricing ask came up during the call: they want committed Dedicated capacity pricing if POC scales. Sales note: keep initial quote conservative, but include an appendix about Dedicated discounts if they commit within 60 days. Ben — will the POC metrics be able to show latency/cost for 1k reqs/min?
Ben (SE): Yes, I can add a small benchmark sheet to the extracts (anonymized perf numbers). Not raw telemetry, just summary: avg latency, p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens.
Maria Lopez: Perfect. I'll update the customer and push NDA. Will follow up here with the signed timestamp.
